dramatic_structure.goal: preserve one visible cause and the distinct responses of a group
dramatic_structure.stakes: the marked route must be cleared before intervention
dramatic_structure.subtext: the lead acts only after every response is visible
dramatic_structure.tactic_change: warning becomes coordinated clearance and then restraint

locked_facts.value: A loose wheel stop is visibly displaced before an unpowered equipment rack begins rolling.
The rack changes from stationary to rolling while three marked lanes remain visible.
After the lanes clear, a floor chock stops the rack and the stopped state remains readable.
